# Deployment

## Overview

S4 deploys as an EV-first algorithmic system for BTCUSDT Futures with walk-forward causal logic, a kill-switch, and Telegram notifications. Source: s4_deploy/README.md.

## Environment Variables Required

~~~
MODE=paper
USE_TESTNET=false
BOT_SYMBOL=BTCUSDT
BOT_TIMEFRAME=1h
INITIAL_EQUITY=1000.0
HEARTBEAT_MIN=60
LOG_LEVEL=INFO

# Binance (not used in paper mode but must exist)
BINANCE_API_KEY=placeholder
BINANCE_API_SECRET=placeholder

# Telegram (REQUIRED to see PnL)
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=your_token
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=your_chat_id
~~~

Note: values above are placeholders as documented in the source README — no real credentials are included in this report.

## Telegram Bot Setup

1. Talk to @BotFather on Telegram, send /newbot.
2. Save the token.
3. Send a message to the bot, then visit https://api.telegram.org/bot TOKEN /getUpdates
4. Copy the chat_id from the result.

## Railway Deploy

~~~
npm install -g @railway/cli
railway login
railway init
railway up
railway logs
~~~

## Telegram Notification Types

| Type | Trigger |
|---|---|
| S4 START | bot startup |
| S4 TRADE | every position open (direction, TP, SL, EV, equity) |
| S4 DAILY | each UTC day change (equity, daily PnL, trades) |
| S4 RISK | kill-switch activation or daily budget exhaustion |
| Daily ledger dump | 00:00 UTC, full CSV, protocol: paste into Google Sheets (solves lack of Railway persistent volume) |

## Weekly Monitoring Targets

| Metric | Target | Alert |
|---|---|---|
| Win rate | >60% | <50% over 50+ trades |
| Expectancy/trade | >$1.50 | <$0.50 |
| Tracking error | <30% | >30% -> consider retrain |
| MDD | <5% | >10% -> review |

## Backtest Reference (S4_causal_safe, Oct 2022 - Sep 2025)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| CAGR | 78.2% |
| MDD | -0.93% |
| Sharpe | 19.5 (inflated by mark-to-market; real estimated 3-8) |
| Win rate | 69% |
| Trades | 2,084 (~2/day) |
| Kill-switch | never triggered |

Note: this is a different window/run than the walk-forward baseline reported in Chapter 2 and walk_summary.json. See Appendix — Data Reconciliation.

## Known Operational Constraints

- No Railway persistent volume — ledger persistence relies on the daily Telegram CSV dump, manually copy-pasted into Google Sheets. This is a manual, failure-prone step and a candidate for automation.
- Binance and Bybit are IP-blocked from Mexico/datacenter regions for microstructure data fetching; OKX is used as the current workaround (see Chapter 4, Gap 5).
